content.text: Let me gauge whether hard32 is findable at all with a big budget:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && timeout 160 python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys, json, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
import compiler
d = json.load(open('tmp/hard32.json'))
links = [tuple(x) for x in d['links']]
env = {int(k): v for k, v in d['env'].items()}
parts = {int(k): v for k, v in d['parts'].items()}
t0 = time.time()
try:
    plan = compiler.compile_plan(links, env, 1, parts, deadline=time.time()+140)
    ok = compiler.verify_plan(links, env, 1, parts, plan)
    print('hard32 verify=%s time=%.1fs' % (ok, time.time()-t0))
except Exception as e:
    print('hard32 FAIL %.1fs' % (time.time()-t0))
EOF
